hardware: 1 AMD Instinct MI300X VF, gfx942, 192 GiB
cache_policy: Use existing installed environment and compilation caches; no warm-up or cache clearing before the timed control.
comparison_objective: Reach a lower full-validation loss in less complete-run wall time. Parameter counts, steps, batches and token budgets may vary for KS3; preserve the underlying token streams and validation definition.
limitations: One seed; exploratory control, not statistical record evidence.
Single-MI300 adaptations and reduced per-step batch are documented in MI300.md.
Trainer timing excludes startup; end-to-end wall time includes launcher, initialization, training, final validation and shutdown.
